entities.summary: Ayshan Abdulazimova is an Azerbaijani volleyball middle-blocker who currently plays for Vasas Obuda in the Hungarian Women's League. Ayshan is also a part of the Azerbaijan women's national volleyball team since 2011. She was appointed as the team captain in January 2020.
